volumes.name: 学术词表 1
words: to examine something in detail to understand it
Researchers analysed data from over 2,000 households.
研究人员分析了两千多个家庭的数据。
a way of dealing with a problem; to come nearer
A more practical approach would be to fund local schools.
更务实的做法是资助本地学校。
a part of a place; a subject or field of activity
Rural areas often lack basic medical services.
农村地区往往缺乏基本的医疗服务。
to judge the quality, value or size of something
It is hard to assess the long-term effects of the policy.
很难评估这项政策的长期影响。
to accept something as true without proof
Many people assume that technology always saves time.
很多人想当然地认为科技总能节省时间。
the power to make decisions; an official organisation
Local authorities are responsible for collecting waste.
地方政府负责收集垃圾。
able to be obtained or used
Free counselling is available to all students.
所有学生都可以获得免费心理辅导。
an advantage; to be helped by something
Regular exercise brings clear benefits to mental health.
规律运动对心理健康有明显的好处。
The concept of lifelong learning has become popular.
终身学习的理念越来越流行。
to be made up of particular parts
The course consists of twelve weekly seminars.
这门课由十二次每周研讨课组成。
comprise, be made up of, be composed of
to form or make up; to be considered as
Women constitute nearly half of the workforce.
女性几乎占了劳动力的一半。
the situation in which something happens
The figures must be understood in their historical context.
这些数字必须放在历史背景下理解。
Many young workers are on short-term contracts.
很多年轻员工签的是短期合同。
to make something new or cause it to exist
Tourism creates thousands of jobs every year.
旅游业每年创造成千上万个工作岗位。
facts or numbers collected to be studied
The data suggest a link between sleep and memory.
数据表明睡眠和记忆之间存在联系。
to say exactly what something means or is
It is difficult to define success in simple terms.
很难用简单的话给成功下定义。
to get something from a source
Most of the country's energy is derived from coal.
该国大部分能源来自煤炭。
to share or give out among people or places
Food aid was distributed to remote villages.
粮食援助被分发到偏远村庄。
the system of trade, industry and money in a country
Tourism is vital to the local economy.
旅游业对当地经济至关重要。
the natural world; the conditions around someone
Children learn best in a supportive environment.
孩子在支持性的环境中学得最好。
to start an organisation; to find out the facts
这个慈善机构成立于 1998 年。
to guess an amount or value roughly
It is estimated that 40 per cent of food is wasted.
据估计，40% 的食物被浪费了。
clear and easy to see or understand
It is evident that the policy has failed.
很明显，这项政策失败了。
to sell goods to another country
China exports electronics to over 200 countries.
中国向两百多个国家出口电子产品。
one of the things that cause or influence a result
Cost is a major factor in choosing a university.
费用是选择大学的一个重要因素。
the management of money; to provide money for
The project is financed by the government.
a fixed method or rule; a mathematical rule
There is no simple formula for happiness.
the purpose of something; to work
The main function of museums is to educate the public.
博物馆的主要功能是教育公众。
to recognise or find out who or what something is
The study identified three main causes of stress.
这项研究确定了压力的三个主要原因。
money received from work or investments
Low-income families spend a larger share on food.
低收入家庭在食物上的开支占比更大。
to show or suggest that something is true
Recent surveys indicate a rise in remote working.
最近的调查显示远程办公有所增加。
a single person; relating to one person
Every individual has a responsibility to reduce waste.
每个人都有减少浪费的责任。
to explain or understand the meaning of something
The results can be interpreted in different ways.
这些结果可以有不同的解读。
to include as a necessary part; to make someone take part
Parents should be involved in their children's education.
家长应该参与孩子的教育。
Housing is a serious issue in big cities.
住房是大城市的一个严重问题。
work, especially physical work; workers as a group
Machines have replaced much manual labour.
机器已经取代了大量体力劳动。
allowed by law; connected with the law
The legal age for driving varies between countries.
法定驾驶年龄因国家而异。
New legislation bans smoking in public places.
新法律禁止在公共场所吸烟。
Traffic is a major cause of air pollution.
交通是空气污染的主要原因。
a particular way of doing something
Online learning is now a common teaching method.
在线学习现在是一种常见的教学方法。
Most road accidents occur close to people's homes.
大多数交通事故发生在住处附近。
Around 60 per cent of adults now shop online.
大约 60% 的成年人现在会网购。
Prices rose sharply over the period from 2010 to 2020.
2010 年到 2020 年间价格急剧上涨。
a plan of action agreed by a government or organisation
The government introduced a new housing policy.
政府推出了新的住房政策。
Equal pay for equal work is an important principle.
同工同酬是一项重要原则。
The project will proceed despite the high cost.
尽管费用很高，项目仍将继续。
a series of actions; to deal with something officially
Learning a language is a slow process.
学语言是一个缓慢的过程。
to need; to make something necessary
Most jobs now require basic computer skills.
现在大多数工作都要求基本的电脑技能。
careful study to discover new facts
Research shows that reading fiction improves empathy.
研究表明读小说能提高同理心。
to reply; to react to something
Governments must respond quickly to public health threats.
政府必须迅速应对公共卫生威胁。
the function or position someone or something has
Parents play a key role in shaping children's values.
父母在塑造孩子的价值观方面起关键作用。
one of the parts of something
A large section of the population lives in poverty.
很大一部分人口生活在贫困中。
a part of the economy or society
Jobs in the service sector have grown rapidly.
服务业的工作岗位增长迅速。
large or important enough to be noticed
There has been a significant increase in obesity.
The two cities face similar problems.
这两个城市面临相似的问题。
Solar power is a clean source of energy.
太阳能是一种清洁能源。
Students need specific feedback on their essays.
学生需要针对作文的具体反馈。
the way parts are arranged; to organise
A clear structure makes an essay easier to follow.
清晰的结构让文章更容易读懂。
In theory, the plan should reduce traffic.
理论上，这个计划应该能减少交通量。
Prices vary greatly from region to region.
各地区的价格差别很大。

volumes.name: 学术词表 2
words: to succeed in doing something after effort
Few countries have achieved full employment.
很少有国家实现了充分就业。
Children acquire languages more easily than adults.
孩子比成年人更容易习得语言。
the work of organising a company or institution
Universities now spend more on administration than before.
大学在行政管理上的花费比以前多。
to have an influence on someone or something
Noise can affect children's ability to concentrate.
噪音会影响孩子的注意力。
Schools must teach appropriate online behaviour.
学校必须教导恰当的网络行为。
one part or feature of a situation
Technology has changed every aspect of our lives.
科技改变了我们生活的方方面面。
Volunteers assist elderly people with their shopping.
a group of things with shared features
Crimes fall into several broad categories.
a part of a book; a period of time
Moving abroad began a new chapter in her life.
出国开启了她人生的新篇章。
an official group; to ask someone to do a piece of work
The report was commissioned by the city council.
这份报告是市议会委托撰写的。
the people living in one area or sharing interests
Libraries are an important part of the community.
图书馆是社区的重要组成部分。
having many connected parts; difficult to understand
Climate change is a complex global problem.
气候变化是一个复杂的全球问题。
The software computes each student's average score.
这个软件会计算每个学生的平均分。
to decide something is true after thinking; to end
The report concluded that the scheme was a success.
报告得出结论：这个计划是成功的。
to organise and carry out an activity
The survey was conducted among 500 teenagers.
这项调查在 500 名青少年中进行。
a result of an action or situation
Deforestation has serious consequences for wildlife.
森林砍伐对野生动物造成严重后果。
the process or work of building
The construction of the new airport took eight years.
新机场的建造花了八年。
to use up; to eat or drink
Developed countries consume far more energy per person.
发达国家的人均能源消耗多得多。
praise for an achievement; buying now and paying later
Many young people buy expensive goods on credit.
很多年轻人用信用贷款购买昂贵的商品。
the customs, beliefs and arts of a group
Travel helps young people understand other cultures.
旅行帮助年轻人了解其他文化。
a plan or drawing; to plan how something will look or work
Good urban design can reduce crime.
好的城市设计能减少犯罪。
There are two distinct groups of learners.
学习者有两类截然不同的群体。
Trust is a key element of any relationship.
信任是任何关系的关键要素。
to consider one thing to be the same as another
Many people equate success with wealth.
很多人把成功等同于财富。
to judge how good or useful something is
Teachers should evaluate students in different ways.
教师应该用不同方式评价学生。
an important part or quality of something
A key feature of the city is its public transport.
这座城市的一大特点是公共交通。
The final decision rests with the government.
to give attention to one particular thing
Schools focus too much on exam results.
学校过于关注考试成绩。
Social media has a huge impact on young people.
社交媒体对年轻人影响巨大。
Sports injuries are common among teenagers.
运动损伤在青少年中很常见。
an organisation for research or education
She works at a research institute in London.
她在伦敦的一家研究所工作。
to put money or effort into something for a future benefit
Governments should invest more in public transport.
政府应该在公共交通上投入更多。
put money into, fund, spend on
a single thing in a list or group
Fresh food is the most wasted item in households.
新鲜食品是家庭浪费最多的东西。
a serious magazine; a written record
The study was published in a medical journal.
这项研究发表在一本医学期刊上。
to keep at the same level; to claim that something is true
It is important to maintain a healthy weight.
保持健康的体重很重要。
Working from home has become normal for many people.
对很多人来说，在家办公已成常态。
to get something, often with effort
Students must obtain a visa before they arrive.
学生必须在抵达前取得签证。
to take part in an activity
Over 300 schools participated in the programme.
有 300 多所学校参加了这个项目。
take part, join in, be involved
to see or understand something in a particular way
Nursing is often perceived as a female job.
护理常被看作女性的工作。
Volunteering has a positive effect on wellbeing.
做志愿者对身心健康有积极影响。
the ability to develop in the future; possible
Every child has the potential to succeed.
每个孩子都有成功的潜力。
Unemployment is lower than in previous years.
The primary aim of prisons should be rehabilitation.
监狱的首要目标应该是改造犯人。
More consumers now purchase groceries online.
越来越多的消费者在网上购买日用品。
范围；（在一定范围内）变动
a variety of things; to vary between two limits
The museum offers a wide range of activities.
博物馆提供各种各样的活动。
a large area of a country or of the world
The northern region relies heavily on farming.
北部地区严重依赖农业。
Governments should regulate the use of personal data.
政府应该规范个人数据的使用。
connected with what is happening or being discussed
Schools should teach skills relevant to modern jobs.
学校应该教与现代工作相关的技能。
a person who lives in a particular place
Local residents oppose the plan for a new airport.
当地居民反对新建机场的计划。
Water is a precious natural resource.
to limit the size, amount or use of something
Some cities restrict car use in the centre.
一些城市限制在市中心开车。
safe; to get something after a lot of effort
Graduates struggle to secure stable jobs.
毕业生很难找到稳定的工作。
to try to find or get something
More people now seek medical advice online.
越来越多的人在网上寻求医疗建议。
Candidates are selected on the basis of merit.
a place where something is, was or will be
The old factory site will become a public park.
旧工厂的地块将改建成公园。
a plan designed to achieve a goal
The city needs a long-term strategy for housing.
这座城市需要长期的住房策略。
a study of opinions or behaviour by asking questions
A recent survey found that most teenagers feel stressed.
最近一项调查发现大多数青少年感到有压力。
written words; a written message sent by phone
Students read a range of texts in class.
学生在课上阅读各种文本。
a belief or custom passed down over time
Festivals help keep local traditions alive.
节日有助于传承当地传统。
to move from one place, person or situation to another
Skills learned at school do not always transfer to work.
在学校学到的技能不一定能用到工作中。

volumes.name: 学术词表 3
words: Cycling is a cheap alternative to driving.
骑车是代替开车的一种便宜选择。
a fact or condition that affects a situation
Families in difficult circumstances need extra support.
处境困难的家庭需要额外的支持。
an opinion; to express an opinion
Many readers left comments under the article.
很多读者在文章下面留了评论。
to pay for a loss; to balance a weakness
Higher salaries cannot compensate for long working hours.
高薪无法弥补长时间工作。
one of the parts of a whole
Exercise is an essential component of a healthy lifestyle.
运动是健康生活方式的重要组成部分。
Companies must obtain consent before collecting personal data.
公司在收集个人数据前必须获得同意。
The plan would cost a considerable amount of money.
这个计划要花相当多的钱。
happening all the time; staying the same
护士在持续的压力下工作。
something that limits what you can do
Budget constraints have forced the library to close early.
预算限制迫使图书馆提早关门。
to help cause something; to give something
有几个因素导致了肥胖。
lead to, play a part in, add to
to bring people together for a meeting
The council convened an emergency meeting.
市议会召开了紧急会议。
to organise people or parts to work well together
Several agencies coordinate the rescue work.
几个机构协调救援工作。
the most important or central part
Maths and English are core subjects.
数学和英语是核心科目。
Corporate taxes fund many public services.
公司税为很多公共服务提供资金。
to match or be similar; to write to someone
The rise in prices corresponds with higher demand.
价格上涨与需求增加相吻合。
standards used to judge something; singular criterion
The scholarship has strict selection criteria.
这个奖学金的选拔标准很严格。
to reach a conclusion from the information you have
From the data we can deduce that demand will rise.
从数据可以推断需求会增加。
to show clearly; to protest in public
The study demonstrates the value of early education.
这项研究证明了早期教育的价值。
an official paper; to record in detail
Keep copies of all important documents.
保存好所有重要文件的副本。
to control or be the most important
A few large firms dominate the market.
少数几家大公司主导着市场。
Schools place too much emphasis on test scores.
to make certain that something happens
Governments must ensure that food is safe.
政府必须确保食品安全。
to deliberately not include someone or something
Poor families are often excluded from good schools.
贫困家庭常被排除在好学校之外。
a basic structure or set of rules
The law provides a framework for protecting workers.
这部法律为保护工人提供了框架。
to provide money for; money for a purpose
Public money should fund basic research.
公共资金应该资助基础研究。
to explain or show with examples or pictures
The chart illustrates changes in energy use.
这张图说明了能源使用的变化。
people coming to live in a country
Immigration has made the city more diverse.
移民使这座城市更加多元。
to suggest something without saying it directly
The figures imply that fewer people are reading books.
这些数字意味着读书的人变少了。
The initial cost of solar panels is high.
太阳能板的初始成本很高。
an example or case of something
For instance, many cities now offer free buses.
例如，很多城市现在提供免费公交。
Children need to interact with others of their age.
孩子需要与同龄人互动。
to give good reasons for something
Nothing can justify cruelty to animals.
什么理由都不能为虐待动物开脱。
a level or sheet of something between others
The ozone layer protects us from harmful sunlight.
臭氧层保护我们免受有害阳光的伤害。
There is a clear link between poverty and crime.
贫困与犯罪之间有明显的联系。
to be in a particular place; to find exactly
The new hospital will be located near the motorway.
新医院将建在高速公路附近。
to make as large as possible
Companies aim to maximise their profits.
公司的目标是利润最大化。
increase, optimise, make the most of
Most of the crimes reported are minor offences.
报案的大多是轻微罪行。
to cancel the effect of something
A poor diet can negate the benefits of exercise.
不良饮食会抵消运动的好处。
the result of a process or event
好老师能提高学习效果。
a person or organisation you work with
The university works closely with industry partners.
这所大学与业界伙伴密切合作。
the study of ideas; a set of beliefs
The school's philosophy is learning through play.
这所学校的理念是在玩中学。
relating to the body; real and solid
Physical activity reduces the risk of disease.
身体活动可以降低患病风险。
a part of a whole; the relation between amounts
A high proportion of graduates work abroad.
很大比例的毕业生在国外工作。
to print and sell a book; to make information public
The results were published last year.
to behave in a particular way because of something
人们对压力的反应各不相同。
to put your name on an official list
All new residents must register with a doctor.
所有新居民都必须在医生那里登记。
to depend on someone or something
The city removed cars from the historic centre.
这座城市把汽车移出了历史中心区。
take away, eliminate, get rid of
A new recycling scheme was introduced last year.
去年推出了一个新的回收计划。
the order in which things happen
Describe the stages in the correct sequence.
按正确的顺序描述各个阶段。
being male or female, especially in society
Pay should not depend on gender.
a change; a period of work
There has been a shift towards online shopping.
The contract specifies the working hours.
合同明确规定了工作时间。
Many students do not get sufficient sleep.
a piece of work to be done
机器人可以执行危险的任务。
relating to practical skills, machines or science
Young people need more technical training.
年轻人需要更多技术培训。
a particular way of doing something
Farmers use modern techniques to save water.
农民使用现代技术来节约用水。
scientific knowledge used in practical ways
Technology has transformed the way we work.
科技改变了我们的工作方式。
legally acceptable; based on good reasons
an amount of something; how loud a sound is
The volume of traffic has doubled.

volumes.name: 话题词：教育与科技
words: the subjects taught in a school or course
Coding should be part of the school curriculum.
编程应该纳入学校课程。
that must be done because of a rule or law
Education is compulsory until the age of sixteen.
十六岁之前接受教育是义务的。
Tuition fees have risen sharply in recent years.
the ability to read and write
Adult literacy rates have improved worldwide.
全世界的成人识字率都有提高。
teaching the skills needed for a particular job
Vocational courses prepare students for work.
职业课程帮助学生为就业做准备。
control of behaviour; a subject of study
Strict discipline does not always improve behaviour.
严格的纪律并不总能改善行为。
Academic success is not the only goal of school.
学业成功并不是上学的唯一目标。
a person who has a university degree
Many graduates cannot find jobs in their field.
很多毕业生找不到对口的工作。
money given to a student to pay for their studies
She won a full scholarship to study in Canada.
她获得了去加拿大留学的全额奖学金。
课外活动能培养团队合作能力。
learning by repetition without real understanding
Rote learning leaves little room for creativity.
死记硬背几乎不给创造力留空间。
the ability to analyse and judge ideas carefully
Universities should develop students' critical thinking.
大学应该培养学生的批判性思维。
a person of the same age or status
Teenagers are strongly influenced by their peers.
青少年深受同龄人的影响。
奖励可以提高学生的积极性。
studying from home through online courses
Distance learning suits people who work full-time.
远程学习适合全职工作的人。
to officially join a course or school
More adults are enrolling in evening classes.
越来越多的成年人报名上夜校。
copying someone else's work and presenting it as your own
Universities use software to detect plagiarism.
to leave school or a course before finishing
Many students drop out because of financial problems.
很多学生因为经济问题辍学。
education at college or university level
Some argue that tertiary education should be free.
有人认为高等教育应该免费。
an experienced person who advises someone less experienced
Young employees benefit from having a mentor.
年轻员工有导师指导会受益。
a new idea, method or invention
the use of machines to do work instead of people
Automation may replace many factory jobs.
自动化可能会取代很多工厂岗位。
computer systems that can do tasks needing human intelligence
Artificial intelligence is changing medical diagnosis.
人工智能正在改变医疗诊断。
Older people may struggle with digital services.
老年人可能难以使用数字化服务。
a machine or tool made for a particular purpose
Children spend hours a day on electronic devices.
孩子们每天在电子设备上花好几个小时。
Cybercrime costs businesses billions every year.
网络犯罪每年给企业造成数十亿损失。
the right to keep personal matters to yourself
Social media raises serious privacy concerns.
社交媒体引发严重的隐私担忧。
the careful watching of people, often by the state
Cameras have increased surveillance in public spaces.
摄像头加强了公共场所的监控。
a set of rules a computer follows to solve a problem
Algorithms decide which videos we see.
算法决定我们看到哪些视频。
no longer used because something newer exists
Many job skills quickly become obsolete.
很多工作技能很快就会过时。
an important new discovery or development
The vaccine was a major medical breakthrough.
这种疫苗是一项重大的医学突破。
这个实验室使用最先进的设备。
政府网站应该简单好用。
time spent looking at phones, computers or TV
Parents worry about their children's screen time.
父母担心孩子的屏幕使用时间。
being unable to stop doing or using something
made to exist by computers; almost
Virtual meetings save time and travel costs.
线上会议节省时间和差旅费。
犯罪分子使用越来越精密的手段。
People replace their gadgets far too often.
人们换电子产品换得太勤了。
easy to reach, use or understand
